name: Reference lock, UX, DESIGN.md, tokens, and planning
binding_chain: approved direction decision and direction-set SHA-256
verified_behaviors: reference lock preserves one dominant visual foundation and no more than three narrow supporting responsibilities
changed direction and direction-set artifacts are rejected by hash
reference lock and direction set must use the same approved understanding
UX requires complete architecture, screens, flows, states, responsive rules, mobile task model, accessibility, and Figma handoff scope
DESIGN.md contains exactly 30 canonical sections in the approved order
DESIGN.md and plan.md are deterministic compiled outputs and stale copies fail aggregate verification
token source uses the stable DTCG 2025.10 schema URL
unknown aliases, alias cycles, and alias type changes are rejected
Display P3, OKLCH, and other supported DTCG color spaces retain declared color-space meaning in CSS
existing token handling requires a new-project, preserve, or map strategy
token compilation writes canonical JSON, CSS, Tailwind, Figma, mobile, and projection-report outputs
px mobile projections are marked high confidence and rem projections remain estimated until root-size verification
implementation waves use earlier-only dependencies and relative file scopes

standard.name: Design Tokens Community Group Format
standard.validation_note: The runtime is standard-library only and validates the primitive token forms it projects. Unsupported composite CSS projections are recorded instead of silently omitted.
